list: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list: 55 trophies — 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned. Names, descriptions and grades are exactly as PlayStation publishes them, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles before this guide was written. Every guide below is written in my own words for this entry and names its sources beside it; no guide text is copied from another guide.
sources_note: List sources: Exophase (GTA VI trophy list) and PSNProfiles (GTA VI trophy list), which agree on every name, description and grade. Method sources named per trophy: GTA Wiki, IGN GTA 6 Wiki and PowerPyx trophy guides — check the cited source for exact launch-day locations, since the game released 19 November 2026 and the community is still mapping spots.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the roadmap in this guide in order (story first, then collectibles, then activities, then money and clean-up) and it will unlock last. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missable_reason: Story mission — complete it during the story flow.
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission 'Gone Fishing' to its end. It is the first mission of the game, so just follow the on-screen objectives and the story; it cannot be skipped and unlocks as the mission completes. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI missions.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missable_reason: Chapter trophy — finish every Chapter 1 mission.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapters end when the last mission of the chapter is done, so keep playing the story in order and this pops at the chapter's closing beat. Do the stranger strands that open in Chapter 1 before moving on if you want them out of the way early. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI story chapters.
sources: GTA Wiki — GTA VI story chapters

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missable_reason: Chapter trophy — finish every Chapter 2 mission.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Same as Chapter 1: play the story missions in order until the chapter closes. The name is printed here exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI story chapters.
sources: GTA Wiki — GTA VI story chapters

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missable_reason: Chapter trophy — finish every Chapter 3 mission.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. By this point new activities and stranger strands keep opening across Leonida — try each activity type once as you go (it counts toward Master of None) instead of leaving them all for the end. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI story chapters.
sources: GTA Wiki — GTA VI story chapters

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missable_reason: Chapter trophy — finish every Chapter 4 mission.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. Before the finale, clear any stranger strands and side missions you still have open — the endgame clean-up is far quicker if the story is fully done first. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI story chapters.
sources: GTA Wiki — GTA VI story chapters

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missable_reason: Final story mission — the story's last beat.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. It unlocks after Chapter 4; finish it and this gold trophy pops with the credits. If you still have collectibles or activities left, they stay available in free roam afterwards, so the final mission is not a point of no return for them. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI final mission.
sources: GTA Wiki — GTA VI final mission

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missable_reason: Named story mission — complete it when it appears.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission 'Breakfast Run' when it appears in the story flow. Play it to the end and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Breakfast Run mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missable_reason: Named story mission — complete it when it appears.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission 'The Cartel Heist' when it appears in the story flow. Heist missions tend to have a setup phase first — finish the setups and then the heist itself to earn this. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — The Cartel Heist mission.
sources: GTA Wiki — The Cartel Heist mission

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missable_reason: Named story mission — complete it when it appears.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission "Child's Play" when it appears in the story flow. Follow the mission objectives to the end; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Child's Play mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missable_reason: Named story mission — complete it when it appears.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission 'Headliners' when it appears in the story flow. Play it through to the mission-complete screen and this pops. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Headliners mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missable_reason: Named story mission — complete it when it appears.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission 'VCIA Takedown' when it appears in the story flow. This is the airport takedown mission — expect a vehicle-focused set piece, and finish it to earn this. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — VCIA Takedown mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missable_reason: Named story mission — complete it when it appears.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission 'Operation Savage Glory' when it appears in the story flow. Play it through to the mission-complete screen. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Operation Savage Glory mission.
sources: GTA Wiki — Operation Savage Glory mission

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. In GTA games this means finishing the story, all stranger and side missions, all activities, all collectibles and all the counted side content — check the in-game stats/progress screen to see which categories are still short. It is the last gold before the platinum for most players: finish everything else first, then use the stats screen to hunt the remaining percent. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — 100% Completion in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — 100% Completion in GTA VI

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, drifts, airtime and other stunt driving, counted by the game as you play. The count builds naturally across the story and free roam, so just drive fast and recklessly between objectives; if you are short at the end, chain stunt jumps and long drifts on open highways and the airport runways until the counter hits 250. Track it on the in-game stats screen. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Stunts in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Stunts in GTA VI

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: shooting range, fishing, racing, drone racing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the other open-world activities the game lists. You do not need to win or finish them — just start and take part in each type once. Do this early, while the story is taking you past the activity spots, so none of them is left for a separate trip. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; IGN — GTA 6 Wiki (activities).

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the shooting ranges across Leonida and work through each weapon challenge, aiming for the gold score threshold the range shows you. Take your time and use the range's own scoring feedback — gold needs accuracy and speed, so learn one challenge's target pattern before rushing the next. This is a grind, not a one-off: expect several sessions. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide (Shooting Range).

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location hosts its own race — fly the course, beat the target time or the rival, and move to the next spot. Drone races reward a steady line over raw speed: learn the gates on a first run, then push for the win on the next. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; IGN — GTA 6 Wiki (Top Fun drone races).
sources: IGN — GTA 6 Wiki (Top Fun drone races)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race you win must be a different one, so repeats do not count. Race across Leonida in cars, bikes and boats as the race types allow, and pick the faster vehicle class for each event. Work through the race list systematically and tick each win off in this guide so you do not re-run one you already won. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Races in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Races in GTA VI

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at the fishing spots and take his challenge — fishing is a timing game, so watch the line tension and reel in steady bursts instead of holding the button down. Win the challenge once and this pops. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; IGN — GTA 6 Wiki (fishing).

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game at an arcade cabinet. Walk up to a cabinet, start a game and play it to its end — any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest one you enjoy. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Arcade games in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Arcade games in GTA VI

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missable_reason: Stranger strand finale — finish Andy's whole strand before the story ends.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's stranger strand. Stranger missions appear as question-mark encounters across Leonida — find Andy, play through every mission in his strand in order, and the finale pops this trophy. Do stranger strands as they open rather than leaving them all for the endgame. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Strangers in GTA VI (Andy).
sources: GTA Wiki — Strangers in GTA VI (Andy)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missable_reason: Stranger strand finale — finish Kenton's whole strand before the story ends.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's stranger strand. Find Kenton, play through his strand mission by mission, and finish the finale. Stranger strands can be easy to walk past, so check the map for the stranger icon whenever you are in a new area. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Strangers in GTA VI (Kenton).
sources: GTA Wiki — Strangers in GTA VI (Kenton)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missable_reason: Stranger strand finale — finish Billy's whole strand before the story ends.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's stranger strand. Track Billy down, work through his missions in order and finish the finale. If a strand seems to stall, check whether the next mission only unlocks after a story chapter or another strand's mission. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Strangers in GTA VI (Billy).
sources: GTA Wiki — Strangers in GTA VI (Billy)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Each strand is a chain of missions for one stranger — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of them, so find three more strangers and finish their chains too. Strangers show as icons on the map; sweep each region for them between story chapters and finish each strand before moving on. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Strangers in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Strangers in GTA VI

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missable_reason: Stranger strand finale — finish Randy's whole strand before the story ends.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's stranger strand. Find Randy, play his missions in order and finish the finale. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Strangers in GTA VI (Randy).
sources: GTA Wiki — Strangers in GTA VI (Randy)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missable_reason: Stranger strand finale — finish Tyrone's whole strand before the story ends.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's stranger strand. Find Tyrone, play his missions in order and finish the finale. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Strangers in GTA VI (Tyrone).
sources: GTA Wiki — Strangers in GTA VI (Tyrone)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are scenic viewpoints — walk to one, use the meditate prompt and let the session finish, then move to the next. They are spread across the whole state, so work through them region by region and tick them off as you go; the GTA Wiki's meditation-spot map is the fastest way to find any you are missing. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Meditation spots in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Meditation spots in GTA VI

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Find Bret and take his hunting work, then track the unique animal he names — use the hunting clues and your weapon of choice, and bring the hunt to a clean end. Unique animals are one-of-a-kind, so follow Bret's guidance rather than hunting at random. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Hunting in GTA VI (Bret).
sources: GTA Wiki — Hunting in GTA VI (Bret)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, interiors and out in the world — and each set needs every card in it. Pick cards up whenever you spot them and check your collection screen to see which sets are close to complete, then use the GTA Wiki's card-location maps to fill the gaps. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Collectible Cards in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Collectible Cards in GTA VI

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. WAiNK is the in-game photo/check-in style activity — open it at scenic spots, landmarks and viewpoints across Leonida and log the location. It counts per location, so repeats do not help: cover the map region by region, and use the GTA Wiki's WAiNK location list to find the last few you are missing. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — WAiNK in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — WAiNK in GTA VI

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's small tracked feats — driving, combat, exploration and activity goals that tick off as you play. They accumulate across everything you do, so just play broadly and check the challenges menu often; near the end, pick off the easiest unfinished ones (short drives, simple combat feats) to reach 50. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Challenges in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Challenges in GTA VI

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missable_reason: Needs your partner beside you at 4 stars — do it during a partner story moment.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. Get the cops to 4 stars (cause chaos near police, then keep moving), then break line of sight, hide until the stars blink, and stay out of the search area until you are clear — with your partner still with you. Easiest during a story stretch where your partner is already riding along. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Wanted level in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Wanted level in GTA VI

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missable_reason: Needs your partner beside you — do it during a partner story moment.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — meaning you must keep the wanted level alive (stay wanted) across all three robberies, back to back. Plan a route of three close shops, rob each quickly, and keep moving between them so the wanted level never drops to zero. If the stars clear, the chain breaks and you start over. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Robberies in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Robberies in GTA VI

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Getting into a new vehicle model for the first time counts as a discovery, so drive everything you see — cars, bikes, trucks, boats and aircraft — and check the vehicle list in the game to see which types you have never driven. Variety beats repetition: a new model in traffic counts, the same sedan for the tenth time does not. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Vehicles in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Vehicles in GTA VI

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the game's slow-motion aiming mode — trigger it in a busy firefight where at least five enemies are in view, and drop them one by one before the focus ends. Pick a mission or shootout with grouped enemies, and use a fast, accurate weapon so all five fall inside the one activation. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Combat Focus in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Combat Focus in GTA VI

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missable_reason: A one-off airport stunt — best done while the VCIA mission puts you there.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the Vice City International Airport — in plain terms, take off in a plane without going through the normal channels. Get a plane on the VCIA runways and get airborne your own way. The VCIA Takedown mission puts you at the airport anyway, so try it while you are there. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — VCIA in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — VCIA in GTA VI

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: This one is about the Rhino tank — the description is the joke itself ('Kinda hot in these Rhinos'). Get into a Rhino tank and use it: drive it and fire its cannon until the trophy pops. Tanks turn up at high wanted levels and military spots, so provoke a heavy police response or find one parked at a military location, then enjoy the ride. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Rhino tank in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Rhino tank in GTA VI

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missable_reason: A clean stealth robbery — one failed attempt can mean a loud, detected run instead.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: move slowly, stay out of sight lines, avoid the cameras and guards, grab the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again later — a detected robbery does not count. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Robberies in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Robberies in GTA VI

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vault robberies are bigger jobs than shop robberies — break into the vault, take the cash and then get clear of the police response before the robbery counts. Plan your escape route before you go in, and use a fast getaway car parked nearby. Five vaults, five clean escapes. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Bank robberies in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Bank robberies in GTA VI

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — find one on the road, stop it (ram it or block it), crack it open, take the cash and lose the police. Watch for a truck on the move and strike where you have a clear escape route. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Armored trucks in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Armored trucks in GTA VI

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map tracks which areas you have visited — drive, fly or sail through every named district and region until the map is fully revealed. Work region by region (Vice City, the Keys, the swamps, the northern towns) and check the map for grey, unvisited patches. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Leonida map in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Leonida map in GTA VI

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Gangs run hidden operations — drug labs, stash houses, smuggling spots — around Leonida. Find one operation per gang, rob it, and move on to the next gang's territory. The GTA Wiki's gang-operation map is the quickest way to locate all nine. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Gangs and illegal operations in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Gangs and illegal operations in GTA VI

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or beachfront spot on Ocean Beach with a sea view, order a cocktail and take in the view — the trophy pops once the moment registers. A quiet, easy one to pick up while you are exploring Vice Beach. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Ocean Beach in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Ocean Beach in GTA VI

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missable_reason: A one-off showroom stunt — do it the first time you are inside a showroom with a car.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom's glass front. Take a car inside (or find one already there), aim for the big glass window and floor it. This is the classic GTA showroom escape, so do it the first time the chance comes up rather than saving it for later. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Vehicle showrooms in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Vehicle showrooms in GTA VI

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — go bowling there and finish a game. Find the alley, pick up a ball and play through a full game; the follow-through is the bowling itself, so complete the game to earn this. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Bowling in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Bowling in GTA VI

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — do something with your partner that the public notices. This is a story-adjacent partner moment: keep playing the partner missions and shared activities, and it pops when the pair pulls off a crowd-pleasing feat together. If it has not popped by the end of the story, replay the partner activities in free roam. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Partner activities in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Partner activities in GTA VI

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missable_reason: Built on choices you make as you play — make choices instead of avoiding them.
trophies.guide: Make choices as you play — PlayStation tracks your choices toward a count of 500. This is about the decisions the game offers you (dialogue picks, mission approaches, moral calls): keep choosing instead of always taking the same path, and the counter climbs. It is a slow burn across the whole game, so do not leave it — decide something every chance you get. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Choices in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Choices in GTA VI

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missable_reason: A second attempt after a failure — fail once, then succeed.
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try: fail something once, then complete it on the next attempt. The trophy is about the comeback — the game notices when an attempt fails and the very next try succeeds. If you fail a mission or activity, retry it right away instead of wandering off; the second-attempt success is what counts. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI trophy guides.
sources: GTA Wiki — GTA VI trophy guides

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — a UFO-style oddity or unexplained event somewhere in Leonida. GTA games hide one weird encounter like this; explore the remote corners of the map at night (the swamps, the Keys, the desert roads) and it will find you. The GTA Wiki's easter-egg pages track exactly where players have seen it since launch. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Easter eggs in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Easter eggs in GTA VI

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — hit a pedestrian with a melee weapon while driving past. Equip a melee weapon (a bat works), drive slowly past someone on foot and swing as you pass. Do it on a quiet street so you control the moment, and keep your wanted level in mind afterwards. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Melee drive-bys in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Melee drive-bys in GTA VI

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — take them to your laundering contacts and convert them to clean cash, little by little, until the total hits $250,000. Rob banks, vaults and armored trucks to keep the supply of Marked Bills coming, and launder often so the total climbs steadily. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Marked Bills in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Marked Bills in GTA VI

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, car mods, food and everything else counts toward the one total. Just buy what you need as you play and the counter climbs; if you are short near the end, spend the rest on weapon upgrades and vehicle mods, which are the priciest single purchases. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Shops in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Shops in GTA VI

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are buyable properties marked on the map — save up, buy each one as you can afford it, and check the property list to see which of the eight you still own. Buying garages also gives you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good, so buy them as you go. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Properties in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Properties in GTA VI

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find ten different vehicles, open the Scooter Bros app on your in-game phone and register each one — any vehicle type the app accepts counts. Do it as you discover new vehicles for Whip It Good, so the two trophies progress together. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Scooter Bros app in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Scooter Bros app in GTA VI

roadmap.title: Story first — Chapters 1–4
roadmap.text: Play the story in order and finish every chapter and named mission. Along the way, try each activity type once (Master of None), keep your partner beside you for Hot Together and Retail Therapy, and pick up stranger strands as they open. Do not rush past the partner moments — they are the missable ones.

roadmap.title: Strangers & side stories
roadmap.text: Finish all 8 stranger strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and three more) and Bret's hunt. Strands unlock across the story, so sweep the map for stranger icons between chapters and finish each strand before the finale.

roadmap.title: Collectibles sweep
roadmap.text: Meditate at all 18 spots, complete 3 card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, discover 100 vehicles, explore all 52 areas, buy all 8 garages and register 10 vehicles to Scooter Bros. Work region by region with the GTA Wiki location maps for the last few of each.

roadmap.title: Activities, skills & money
roadmap.text: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, win 20 races and 14 drone races, pull off 250 stunts, finish 50 challenges, rob 5 bank vaults and one operation per gang, launder $250,000 of Marked Bills and spend $100,000 in shops. This is the long grind — spread it across the whole playthrough, not one sitting.

roadmap.title: Clean-up & platinum
roadmap.text: Check the in-game stats screen for the last few percent of 100% completion, mop up anything left, and the gold for 100% pops — then the platinum, Vice Got a Price!, pops with it.

missable_summary: 24 trophies are flagged missable in this guide: the 12 chapter and named story missions, the 5 stranger-strand finales, the two partner-moment trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy), the one-off stunts (Catch Me If You Can, Capital Offense), the stealth robbery (Sneakthief), the choices trophy (Actions Speak Louder) and the second-attempt trophy (Bad Luck, I Guess). Every other trophy can be earned in free roam after the story ends.
